review_policy: Review at least annually and after any material change or broken-link report.

resources.name: Alzheimers.gov
resources.mission: A U.S. government portal for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias, including symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, caregiving, research, and clinical-trial information.
resources.alignment: It gives visitors a federal, evidence-based starting point without asking Leave One Light On to act as a medical authority.
resources.benefits: People living with dementia, family members, caregivers, health professionals, and anyone seeking trustworthy federal information.
resources.search_keywords: Alzheimer Alzheimer's dementia memory caregiving caregiver diagnosis treatment clinical trials federal government NIA

resources.name: National Institute on Aging — Alzheimer's & Dementia
resources.mission: Provides evidence-based information about Alzheimer's disease and other dementias, including diagnosis, treatment, caregiving, and related research.
resources.alignment: NIA is a primary federal health-information source and supports the movement's truth-before-momentum standard.
resources.benefits: People seeking authoritative health information, caregivers, families, and professionals.
resources.search_keywords: Alzheimer Alzheimer's dementia memory aging NIH NIA caregiver diagnosis treatment research

resources.name: Alzheimer's Association
resources.mission: Provides Alzheimer's and dementia information, caregiver support, local resources, research information, and a free 24/7 helpline.
resources.alignment: It offers a practical national support path for families while Leave One Light On remains a storyteller and connector rather than a clinical provider.
resources.benefits: People living with Alzheimer's or another dementia, caregivers, families, and people seeking local support or information.
resources.search_keywords: Alzheimer Alzheimer's dementia memory caregiver caregiving support helpline local resources 800 272 3900

resources.name: The ALS Association
resources.mission: Provides programs, care navigation, education, support groups, caregiver resources, clinic connections, advocacy, and research information for people affected by ALS.
resources.alignment: It gives families facing ALS a direct path to disease-specific support and specialized care resources.
resources.benefits: People living with ALS, caregivers, family members, veterans, and people seeking local ALS support or specialized clinics.
resources.search_keywords: ALS amyotrophic lateral sclerosis Lou Gehrig disease caregiver support clinics care navigation research

resources.name: NINDS — Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
resources.mission: Provides federal research information and resources about ALS through the National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke.
resources.alignment: It adds an authoritative NIH source alongside practical nonprofit support for people who want to understand the disease and current research.
resources.benefits: People seeking federal ALS research information, families, caregivers, clinicians, and people considering research participation.
resources.search_keywords: ALS amyotrophic lateral sclerosis NIH NINDS Lou Gehrig disease research clinical trials neurological
